system.name: ServerlessLLM
system.one_liner: a low-latency serverless inference system for large language models that optimizes checkpoint loading, live migration and scheduling

components.name: Controller
components.role: top-level cluster scheduler orchestrating request routing and model loading scheduling

components.name: Request Router
components.role: routes inference requests to servers and reports inference status to the scheduler

components.name: ServerlessLLM Model Loading Scheduler
components.role: assigns model loading tasks to servers using time estimators

components.name: Model Loading Time Estimator
components.role: assesses loading times from various storage media

components.name: Model Migration Time Estimator
components.role: estimates times for necessary model migrations

components.name: Model Loading Task Queues
components.role: queues holding pending loading tasks per server

components.name: Reliable Key-Value Store
components.role: stores server, GPU, DRAM and SSD status used by the controller

components.name: Server 1
components.role: server holding Model C on GPU and Model B in DRAM

components.name: Server 2
components.role: server holding Model A on GPU/DRAM and Model B on SSD

components.name: Server 3
components.role: server holding Model A on SSD only

content.key_idea: The controller's model loading scheduler uses loading- and migration-time estimators over live server/GPU/storage status (from a reliable key-value store) to decide, for a request needing a model already cached at some tier on another server, whether to load or migrate it, minimizing startup time.
content.reading_order: left to right: an inference request enters the Controller's Request Router and Model Loading Scheduler on the left, which issues loading tasks to and receives results/status from the three servers on the right, each shown with the tiers (GPU/DRAM/SSD) holding different models.

summary: This figure shows the design of ServerlessLLM's startup-time-optimized model loading scheduler, which lives inside the cluster Controller alongside the Request Router. The scheduler contains a Model Loading Time Estimator (assessing load times from different storage media) and a Model Migration Time Estimator (estimating migration times), feeding per-server Model Loading Task Queues. The Controller exchanges loading tasks and results with three example servers, each depicted with a GPU/DRAM/SSD stack showing where models A, B and C currently reside (e.g., Model A on Server 2's GPU/DRAM versus only on Server 3's SSD), illustrating the scheduler's decision of whether to load or migrate a model. A Reliable Key-Value Store supplies the controller with live server, GPU, DRAM and SSD status. The diagram is a flat, left-to-right hub-and-spoke box diagram with the scheduler box highlighted in light blue and letter markers (A, B) tying specific model instances to the text's worked example.
summary_zh: 图5展示ServerlessLLM启动时间优化的模型加载调度器设计：控制器内的调度器包含模型加载时间估计器与模型迁移时间估计器，依据可靠键值存储提供的服务器/GPU/DRAM/SSD状态，向各服务器下发加载任务；图中以字母标记(A、B)示例说明模型A在不同服务器不同存储层级的分布，用于估算加载与迁移耗时。
